verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-premises edition of Trello. The docs only cover the cloud product (developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello), and community comments describe it as SaaS. One user asks for an installable version that doesn't appear to exist, and another left for open-source WeKan.
